releaseNotes: Dev | Prod switch on the sign-in screen (new installs start on Prod; handhelds already used on dev keep Dev; DEV badge on Home and Settings). Parts are matched by kind, walk-in parts can leave as Sold, Rental or Pay per shipment, plates that join the customer's PCM pool are shown as such, purchases carry a SALE marker, requests say who preconditions. New: Parts run (one destination, many parts) and bulk product outbound by quantity. Note: the prod backend does not have the new part features yet (parts by kind, walk-in rental, pool replies) until logistic is promoted; the app handles the older server.
